title: Key West Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Key West is a just renovated to the studs home located in a prime location only 125 feet to the beach and 4 minute walk to downtown Seaside, private open air porch, all new appliances, and more!
description_expanded: Description23 ODESSA STREET1 Queen - Sleeps 2Welcome to Key West | A Romantic Seaside Cottage for TwoWelcome to Key West, a boutique hideaway cottage for two in Seaside, Florida, perfectly positioned just steps from the beach. This newly renovated bungalow offers an intimate coastal retreat with an unbeatable location—only 125 feet from private Seaside beach access, a 2-minute walk to the West Side Pool, and a 4-minute stroll to Central Square. With more than 35 shops and restaurants nearby, everything Seaside is known for is right outside your door.Prime Location with Rare Off-Street ParkingGuests enjoy the rare convenience of reserved off-street parking, a true luxury in Seaside. From the parking area, a peaceful boardwalk path leads you to the cottage, setting the tone for a relaxed and private stay. The open-air front porch invites you to slow down—an ideal spot for morning coffee while enjoying Gulf breezes and the gentle sounds of the nearby shoreline.Thoughtfully Designed Coastal LivingInside, Key West is a beautifully designed two-level retreat created with comfort and simplicity in mind. The first floor features an open living area with cozy seating and a 42-inch wall-mounted TV, perfect for quiet evenings after the beach. The galley-style kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, including an oven, glass cooktop, refrigerator/freezer, dishwasher, and custom cabinetry stocked with cookware and glassware. A charming dining area completes the space, ideal for meals at home.Private Loft Suite with Juliette BalconyA graceful curved staircase leads to the queen-bedded loft suite, offering privacy and comfort upstairs. This inviting space includes a second TV, ceiling fan, and a private ensuite bath with a modern walk-in shower and updated fixtures. Step onto the Juliette balcony to take in the sights and sounds of Seaside—a peaceful perch for unwinding at the end of the day.Comfort-Focused Amenities for a Relaxing StayEvery detail at Key West has been carefully considered. Guests enjoy separate upstairs and downstairs air-conditioning systems, upgraded dimmable lighting, adjustable shutters on screened windows, ceiling fans in the bedroom and bathroom, and a stacked washer and dryer. After a beach day, rinse off in the private outdoor shower, then settle in with premium linens and thoughtful touches throughout.Seaside Amenities & Thoughtful ExtrasYour stay includes courtesy bicycles, wristbands for private beach access, and access to Seaside’s three swimming pools, fitness center, tennis courts, and pickleball courts. A complimentary bottle of wine awaits on arrival, adding to the relaxed, welcoming experience.An Ideal Seaside Escape for TwoWhether you’re planning a romantic getaway or a peaceful coastal escape, Key West offers the perfect blend of privacy, location, and Seaside charm. Book your stay and experience effortless beach living just steps from the Gulf.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Features504 square feet125 feet | 1-minute walk to private Seaside beach access at Odessa PavilionSeaside residential beaches, the largest stretch of private beach on 30AEnclosed outdoor showerNew stackable washer and dryerAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowed
